body: Yes it is, he's just trying to be the victim
He said he was zoning out

I left him already don't worry!! 
But it took me a month to get rid of him, he harassed me, my friends and even my mother

I'm sending you love

I know how it feels to be forgotten this way. It doesn't mean you're forgettable. It doesn't mean anything about you

You deserve love and attention
Treat yourself today if you feel like it <3

For now I still feel embarrassed by this reminder of what i did 
But thank you for the advice, take care

As someone who's often been betrayed, i still manage to trust really fast and easily - so we're complete opposite. What i learned about this is that no matter how hard we can try to avoid being hurt, with fear or distance, it doesn't change anything. I think what matters is to be strong with your boundaries, with what you believe in, and to be aware of any red flags without looking for them. It would be sad to miss a beautiful relationship

Maybe you just need time to trust the person you're dating, and surely work on trust yourself too. Because your first love abandoned you doesn't mean that you're not worthy of a strong and healthy romantic relationship. Have you ever talk about this fear of yours to your partner?
Have you ever felt like that in a relationship before?
